halves_read: data half (mods/*/rules YAML, ra mission Lua ant-01 and ant-03, glsl shaders); code half by cited lines only (OpenRA.Mods.D2k, OpenRA.Mods.Common, OpenRA.Mods.Cnc). Engine render path and OpenRA.Server not read.

counts_basis.creatures: ra 5 (Zombie, Ant, ScoutAnt, FireAnt, WarriorAnt) + d2k 1 (sandworm) + ts 4 (DOGGIE, VISC_SML, VISC_LRG, JFISH); 3 more decorative interior critters (QUEE, LAR1, LAR2) not counted
counts_basis.classes: 24 infantry actor keys in ra/rules/infantry.yaml, including the SPY.England variant
counts_basis.weapons: top-level weapon keys by grep: ra 82, cnc 58, d2k 48, ts 65
counts_basis.gear_sets: none in the box; armour classes are the nearest analogue
counts_basis.zones: tileset files: ra 4, cnc 4, d2k 1, ts 2

creature_families: Ant brood (ra): Ant base (cost 300, speed 92), ScoutAnt (light, HP 8500), FireAnt (heavy, fireball, HP 7500), WarriorAnt (heavy, heavy mandible, HP 12500); last three not player-buildable, spawned by mission Lua
Shambler (ra): Zombie, bio-built, cost 100, HP 25000, speed 39, claw
Visceroid slime line (ts): VISC_SML small (HP 20000, merges on crush), VISC_LRG large (HP 50000, heavy, ranged slime)
Hover jelly (ts): JFISH, hover locomotor, HP 50000, speed 72
Hound (ts): DOGGIE, HP 25000, light, hides on tiberium when still, fire-death variant
Sand maw (d2k): sandworm, HP 100000, heavy, worm locomotor, speed 42, noise-hunting burrower
Decorative interior critters (ra): Queen Ant and larvae, no combat, interior tileset only

top_creatures.label: Sand Maw
top_creatures.why: burrowing beast that hunts by summed noise, telegraphs a bite from under the target cell, may leave after biting
top_creatures.keep: noise-attraction pull, 3-cell instant-bite radius, burrow countdown before the bite, return delay, chance to leave after biting
top_creatures.change: ground shadow and dust rise instead of a burrow sprite; bite picks the most-engaged fighter; fixed despawn timer with grace instead of a coin-flip

top_creatures.label: Merge-slime
top_creatures.why: a small slime that runs over another turns into a large one; reads as a clear size pop at 375 px
top_creatures.keep: crush-triggered transform into the large form; large form has a ranged slime every 80 ticks
top_creatures.change: 2-second stationary channel before merge; merged form capped at one size step; our own goo colour

top_creatures.label: Hover Jelly
top_creatures.why: large floating body on a hover locomotor, a silhouette no other beast in the box has
top_creatures.keep: hover over water and land, 5-cell reveal radius, 50000 HP
top_creatures.change: low pulsing hum and a body that rides above fog; no slime attack

top_creatures.label: Shade Hound
top_creatures.why: lies flat and vanishes into tiberium when still; comes up on movement or attack; burning death variant
top_creatures.keep: hide only when still on a hazard terrain, show when moving or attacking, heal on that terrain
top_creatures.change: spore-moss hazard terrain; burning death kept as a fire-death sequence, not a sprite

top_creatures.label: Warrior Brood
top_creatures.why: heaviest ant, heavy armour, double-burst heavy mandible; the escalation tier after the scout
top_creatures.keep: heavy armour, double-burst melee (damage 10000 per hit as written), slower walk than the scout, 12500 HP
top_creatures.change: three-hit combo with a clear wind-up cue; boss-tier escort, no prerequisite gate

top_creatures.label: Fire Brood
top_creatures.why: the only ranged ant; fires a fireball, heavy armour, capped by the wave director
top_creatures.keep: ranged fire attack from a brood body; scarce count per wave
top_creatures.change: slow ember arc with a ground smoulder instead of a fireball sprite

top_creatures.label: Scout Brood
top_creatures.why: light fast ant with a wider scan radius (7 cells); the opening wave unit
top_creatures.keep: light armour, scan radius 7, fast body (speed 92 from the Ant base)
top_creatures.change: faster chirp on spotting; scan cut to 5 cells so it does not sweep the zone

top_creatures.label: Shambler
top_creatures.why: cheap, very high-HP bio-built body that bites; reads as a slow wall at 375 px
top_creatures.keep: slow tanky melee body, low cost, claw attack with a long idle
top_creatures.change: fast-died swarm member with hit-stop instead of a 25000-HP wall

classes: rifle (E1, carbine); grenadier (E2); rocket (E3, two weapons); flamethrower (E4); engineer (E6, cost 400, no weapon line found); commando (E7, HP 10000, cost 1800); spy (SPY, silenced pistol); medic (MEDI, heal); mechanic (MECH, repair); thief (THF, cloak after 120 ticks, detects cloaked units); shock trooper (SHOK, portable tesla); attack dog (DOG, jaw); heroes (EINSTEIN, DELPHI, CHAN, GNRL)
RA factions: allies and soviet families, with nation sub-factions (england, france, germany; russia, ukraine) in ra/rules/misc.yaml ValidFactions
TS factions: GDI and Nod unit files; mutants (civilian-infantry) and cyborgs (nod-infantry) not read in full
D2K houses: Atreides, Harkonnen, Ordos, each with a construction yard (d2k/rules/structures.yaml); thumper (deploys as a worm lure) and fremen (cloak with critical reveal)
weapon_families: Claw and mandible creature melee: Claw (reload 30), Mandible (burst 2), MandibleHeavy (burst 2, reload 15, damage 10000 as written)
Fire family: FireWeapon base (napalm effect, scorch smudge), Flamer (cone), FireballLauncher (two-shot), AntFireball
Tesla family: TeslaZap, PortaTesla (shock trooper), TTankZap
Worm jaw (d2k): WormJaw excludes structures and infantry, so it bites vehicles only
Slime (ts): SlimeAttack, damage 10000, reload 80, excludes walls and bridges
Deviator missile (d2k): damage 2000 in a 480 spread, ChangeOwner warhead for 405 ticks, zero vs invulnerable, half vs construction yards
gear_tiers: No gear sets or material tiers in the box.

Armour classes (Versus keys): none, wood, light, heavy, concrete, tree, invulnerable. Each weapon has a multiplier per class (claw: None 97, Wood 10, Light 30, Heavy 10, Concrete 10; mandible heavy: Light 90, Heavy 35).
Veterancy ladder: XP thresholds 200, 400, 800, 1600 each add a veteran level; level 4 unlocks elite (damage taken x75 percent, firepower up). ra/rules/defaults.yaml:47-80.
Iron curtain: timed invulnerability, zero damage multiplier, translucent overlay and a timed bar (ra/rules/defaults.yaml:166-176).
Husk wrecks: destroyed vehicles leave husk actors with owner kept (ra/rules/husks.yaml, 36 keys; d2k/rules/vehicles.yaml:592).
zones: Biomes (tilesets): temperate, snow, desert, interior (ra); temperate, snow, desert, winter (cnc); arrakis (d2k); snow, temperate (ts). Each biome has its own palette set.
Dungeon archetype: ant nest with hive killzones (ra/maps/ant-03/ant-03.lua:55-57; mission tileset not checked).
Spice field (d2k): spice bloom spawnpoints self-clear after 3000-3250 ticks while sand is clear; sandworms roam sand (arrakis.yaml:1-40).
Tiberium field (ts, cnc): tiberium heals ts beasts (-200 per 16 ticks) and hides hounds (ts/rules/defaults.yaml:1326-1330; critters.yaml:44-45).
Veins (ts): 500 bullet-type damage per 16 ticks on veins terrain (ts/rules/defaults.yaml:1334-1335).
Scorch smudge (ra): fire weapons leave ground marks (ra/weapons/other.yaml:18).

looks.label: Chronoshift pulse
looks.technique: full-screen pass desaturating to mid-luminance; blend falls linearly from full to zero over 60 ticks

looks.label: Colour flash
looks.technique: full-screen mix toward one colour by a blend value

looks.label: Warp ring from displacement sheet
looks.technique: 48 precomputed displacement frames in one sheet; displacement from encoded offset channels; ring cut off by an intensity channel; frames are map-package lookup files not in the box

looks.label: Shock ring
looks.technique: screen offsets scaled by normalised radius, discarded outside the unit circle

looks.label: Iron curtain tint
looks.technique: translucent colour overlay as a render modifier on a condition, plus timed bar

looks.label: Owner-coloured projectile and blast
looks.technique: trail and explosion palette follow the owner

looks.label: Sand trail
looks.technique: trail image every 3 ticks while moving on sand terrains

looks.label: Team colour remap (audit only)
looks.technique: 16 reserved palette indices remapped from one player colour; not re-read in this pass

looks.label: Fog of war states (audit only)
looks.technique: three source states with separate shroud and fog palettes; not re-read in this pass

originals.name: Sand Maw
originals.idea: a noise-hunting burrower that telegraphs its bite from the ground and bites the most-engaged fighter
originals.keep: noise pull toward the summed attraction; 3-cell instant radius; burrow countdown and return delay
originals.change: shadow ring and dust rise as the telegraph; fixed despawn timer replaces the chance-to-leave

originals.name: Brood Wave Director
originals.idea: scouts first, fire brood after a time gate, wave cap by difficulty, re-armed on a fixed interval
originals.keep: time-gated tier unlock, difficulty cap, fixed re-arm interval
originals.change: fix the off-by-one so the rolled amount is spawned, not one more; cap rises or holds flat; the normal-difficulty early warrior swap is dropped unless intended

originals.name: Merge Slime
originals.idea: two small slimes fuse into one large slime on contact
originals.keep: crush-transform trigger; large form has a ranged slime
originals.change: 2-second stationary channel; single size step; our goo colour

originals.name: Shade Hound
originals.idea: a hound hidden on hazard terrain only while still, healing there

originals.name: Chrono Pulse
originals.idea: 60-tick mid-luminance desaturation with linear blend-out for a special ability
originals.change: cool rim flash; local camera only

originals.name: Phase Scout
originals.idea: a scout that cloaks after a short delay and is forced visible at critical health
originals.keep: cloak delay; breaks on attack, damage and heal; forced reveal at critical
originals.change: our shimmer; forced reveal at 25 percent health

originals.name: Breakdown Responder
originals.idea: a responder that starts by inspecting a downed rig and switches to repair when the fault shows
originals.keep: mid-job upgrade from inspect to fix
originals.change: player-summoned revive of a downed teammate in the fight zone

originals.name: Veteran Ladder with Elite
originals.idea: four XP thresholds; at level four an elite cuts damage taken
originals.change: elite cuts 15 percent with a rank pip

originals.name: Armour-Class Table
originals.idea: each weapon has a multiplier per armour class, so each weapon has a hard counter
originals.keep: per-class multiplier table and hard counters
originals.change: cloth, leather, plate and crystal classes; fewer weapon entries

originals.name: Nest Killzone
originals.idea: a named nest with an entry footprint that punishes one enemy type on entry, so the nest is a trap as well as a spawn point
originals.keep: named nest per id; entry trigger on a footprint; objective to clear every nest
originals.change: timed shock that staggers instead of an instant kill; shrine lure draws the player in
